narrative.intro: Medline Industries obligated $806M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Medline Industries received 678 awards so far, with an average award size of $1.2M, and obligations were up 39.2% year over year. Medline Industries has grown its federal business steadily since FY21, when obligations were $262M, rising through FY22 ($281M), FY23 ($337M), FY24 ($370M), and FY25 ($579M) before reaching the current FY26 total. Medline Industries sells primarily through the Medical, Dental, and Hospital Equipment and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers market, which accounted for $769M of obligations in FY2026 to date. The Department of Veterans Affairs is the dominant buyer, obligating $763M. Other agencies with FY2026 obligations include the Department of Health and Human Services at $32M, the Department of Justice at $10M, the Department of the Treasury at $295K, the Department of the Interior at $109K, and the Department of Defense at $63.1K. Medline Industries also shows smaller FY2026 activity in Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing at $35.8M and several other NAICS categories.

sections.heading: How did Medline Industries' federal obligations change year over year?
sections.body: Medline Industries obligated $806M in FY2026 to date, up 39.2% year over year. Medline Industries increased obligations each fiscal year from FY21 ($262M) through FY26 ($806M). Medline Industries saw the largest single-year jump from FY25 ($579M) to FY26 ($806M).

sections.heading: Who are Medline Industries' top federal customers in FY2026?
sections.body: The Department of Veterans Affairs is the largest buyer, obligating $763M in FY2026 to date. Medline Industries also sold to the Department of Health and Human Services ($32M) and the Department of Justice ($10M), with smaller obligations from the Department of the Treasury ($295K), the Department of the Interior ($109K), and the Department of Defense ($63.1K).

faq.q: How much does Medline Industries make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Medline Industries obligated $806M from federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Medline Industries received 678 awards in the period, with an average award size of $1.2M, and obligations were up 39.2% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Medline Industries?
faq.a: The Department of Veterans Affairs is the top buyer, obligating $763M. Medline Industries also had FY2026 obligations from the Department of Health and Human Services ($32M), the Department of Justice ($10M), the Department of the Treasury ($295K), the Department of the Interior ($109K), and the Department of Defense ($63.1K).

faq.q: What does Medline Industries sell to the government?
faq.a: Medline Industries sells medical and related supplies, led by Medical, Dental, and Hospital Equipment and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers at $769M in FY2026 to date. Medline Industries also has activity in Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing ($35.8M), Surgical Appliance and Supplies Manufacturing ($916K), In-Vitro Diagnostic Substance Manufacturing ($173K), and several smaller NAICS categories.
